# Datasource: `demo_database` — 8 model(s)
- `customers` (2 cols; joins: `orders`, `tweets`)
- `items` (4 cols; joins: `orders`, `products`)
- `orders` (9 cols; joins: `customers`, `items`, `stores`)
- `products` (5 cols; joins: `items`, `supplies`)
- `stores` (4 cols; joins: `orders`)
- `supplies` (5 cols; joins: `products`)
- `time_spine` (1 cols; joins: _(none)_)
- `tweets` (4 cols; joins: `customers`)

# Model: `supplies`

- **data_source:** `demo_database`
- **sql_table:** `supplies`
- **row_count:** 65

## Columns (5)

| name | type | primary_key | allowed_aggregations | label | description | sampled |

| id | TEXT | yes | all | — | — | — |
| name | TEXT | — | all | Supply | Supply name. | 16oz compostable clear cup, 16oz compostable clear lid, biodegradable straw, bread, compostable cutlery - knife, cutlery - fork, napkin, serving boat, cheese, coffee, banana, beef stew, chai mix, french vanilla syrup, ghost pepper sauce, house-pickled cabbage sauerkraut, kiwi, lamb and pork bratwurst, lime, mango |
| cost | INT | — | all | Unit Cost (cents) | Cost per unit, in cents. | 4 .. 234 |

## Learnings (1)

- **Mjaffle-money-in-cents** (`demo_database.supplies.cost`): Money is stored as **integer cents**. On `orders` the columns `subtotal`, `tax_paid`, and `order_total` are cents; so are `products.price` and `supplies.cost`. Do not `sum` these raw columns for a dollar figure. Use the `dollars` aggregation (`order_total:dollars`) or the pre-built dollar measures (`total_revenue`, `net_sales`, `tax_collected`, `avg_order_value`), which divide by 100.

# Model: `items`

Order line items. One row per unit sold (no quantity column): units = row count. Join to orders for dates/stores and to products for name, type and price. For any sales-by-product, product-mix or category-share question, use the line_sales measure here. Do NOT use products.price:sum from this model: it sums each distinct product's price once, not once per item sold.

- **data_source:** `demo_database`
- **sql_table:** `items`
- **row_count:** 1,742,698
